<!--
termpdf-rs is opinionated about scope. Before filing, please skim
README and CONTRIBUTING.md to see whether this is the kind of
change we'd consider. The short version:
- We *want* power/latency wins, correctness fixes, and improvements
  to the kitty / sixel rendering paths.
- We're cautious about new dependencies, new keybinds, and new
  UI surfaces.
-->

## Scope check

- [ ] This does not require a new top-level dependency.
- [ ] This does not require a new always-on background task.
- [ ] This does not regress idle CPU or wire bytes.
- [ ] (If a UI change) This does not steal focus from reading.

<!-- If any of the above are unchecked, please discuss the tradeoff. -->
